originality.rationale: Papadatos (arXiv:2205.10799) derives the UMVUEs and their finite-variance thresholds and supplies the ratio density; its inspected main theorem does not state regularly varying tails or full arbitrary-q moments. Generic Breiman product laws are prior tools; their application needs a new endpoint analysis and yields three explicit constants and the logarithmic crossover. Older ratio-distribution originals were only identified, not read and remain a plausible priority risk.
